findings.title: Decorative status icons are exposed to assistive technology
findings.detail: The health status ShieldCheck icon has no aria-hidden attribute, and the same omission occurs for the decorative ReceiptText icon in the reconciliation heading and the ActionBanner status icon (lines 368 and 419). The surrounding text and status semantics already convey the meaning, so these icons should be hidden from the accessibility tree to avoid redundant announcements.
